title: Design System: FinPulse Methodology Review Artifacts

display.purpose: The single report title; compact enough to leave the coverage picture in the first viewport.

headline.purpose: Names a new layer in the overview-to-evidence path.

body.purpose: Competency wording, methodology, and evidence prose.

label.purpose: Controls and compact metadata without uppercase costume.

shadows.name: sticky-separation
shadows.purpose: Separates the sticky filter bar from moving ledger content.

shadows.name: disclosure-overlay
shadows.purpose: Places the expanded secondary-filter sheet above the registry on wide screens.

motion.name: coverage-map-reveal
motion.purpose: One first-load clip reveal for the aggregate coverage field; removed under reduced motion.

components.name: Status Summary
components.description: Count, percentage, mark, and ledger filter in one unboxed status fact.
components.css: .ds-status-summary { display:grid; grid-template-columns:auto 1fr; gap:2px 12px; padding:14px 16px; color:var(--covered); border:0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); background:transparent; text-align:left; font:inherit; } .ds-status-summary span { grid-row:1 / span 2; display:grid; width:22px; height:22px; place-items:center; border:1px solid currentColor; border-radius:4px; } .ds-status-summary strong { font-size:36px; line-height:1; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-status-summary small { color:var(--muted); } .ds-status-summary:hover { background:rgba(32,41,37,.035); } .ds-status-summary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-status-summary[aria-pressed=true] { box-shadow:inset 0 -3px 0 currentColor; }

components.name: Filter Field
components.description: A neutral 44px field for primary search and filtering.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:6px; color:var(--muted); font:650 12px/1.35 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-field input { height:44px; padding:0 12px; color:var(--ink); border:1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius:7px; background:var(--surface); font:400 15px/1.4 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color:var(--ink); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Disclosure Control
components.description: A native summary control for secondary filters or deeper analytical cuts.
components.css: .ds-disclosure summary { display:flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; padding:0 12px; color:var(--ink); border:1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius:7px; background:var(--surface); font:650 13px/1.35 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif; list-style:none; } .ds-disclosure summary::after { content:'+'; margin-left:auto; } .ds-disclosure[open] summary::after { content:'−'; } .ds-disclosure summary:hover { border-color:var(--ink); } .ds-disclosure summary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-disclosure div { padding:16px; }

components.name: Covered Registry Row
components.description: Full-row verified field with redundant mark and written status.
components.css: .ds-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:110px 1fr 180px; gap:16px; align-items:start; padding:14px; color:var(--ink); border-bottom:1px solid rgba(70,84,77,.2); font:400 14px/1.42 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-row code { font-family:SFMono-Regular,Consolas,monospace; } .ds-row strong { font-weight:650; } .ds-row span { font-weight:720; } .ds-covered { background:var(--covered-bg); } .ds-covered span { color:var(--covered); } .ds-covered:hover { background:var(--covered-hover); } .ds-covered:focus-within { outline:3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset:-3px; }

components.name: Partial Registry Row
components.description: Full-row qualified field with redundant mark and written status.
components.css: .ds-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:110px 1fr 180px; gap:16px; align-items:start; padding:14px; color:var(--ink); border-bottom:1px solid rgba(70,84,77,.2); font:400 14px/1.42 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-row code { font-family:SFMono-Regular,Consolas,monospace; } .ds-row strong { font-weight:650; } .ds-row span { font-weight:720; } .ds-partial { background:var(--partial-bg); } .ds-partial span { color:var(--partial); } .ds-partial:hover { background:var(--partial-hover); } .ds-partial:focus-within { outline:3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset:-3px; }

components.name: Gap Registry Row
components.description: Full-row uncovered field with redundant mark and written status.
components.css: .ds-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:110px 1fr 180px; gap:16px; align-items:start; padding:14px; color:var(--ink); border-bottom:1px solid rgba(70,84,77,.2); font:400 14px/1.42 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-row code { font-family:SFMono-Regular,Consolas,monospace; } .ds-row strong { font-weight:650; } .ds-row span { font-weight:720; } .ds-gap { background:var(--gap-bg); } .ds-gap span { color:var(--gap); } .ds-gap:hover { background:var(--gap-hover); } .ds-gap:focus-within { outline:3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset:-3px; }

components.name: Evidence Detail Button
components.description: Neutral non-status action for opening the evidence attached to one row.
components.css: .ds-detail-button { min-height:44px; padding:6px 9px; color:var(--action); border:1px solid rgba(41,79,101,.55); border-radius:6px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.42); font:680 12px/1.3 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-detail-button:hover, .ds-detail-button[aria-expanded=true] { color:white; border-color:var(--action); background:var(--action); } .ds-detail-button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview: This system governs standalone evidence-review artifacts under docs/methodology/. It does not replace docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md for the learner SPA or define the internal admin interface. Standalone methodology reviews behave like conservation condition reports crossed with scientific atlases: the whole state is legible first, while every conclusion remains traceable to a precise record. The system is role-neutral and must be equally useful to a human reviewer and to an agent determining the next piece of work. The world is quiet, cool, and exact without becoming corporate. It rejects the category-default KPI dashboard as well as the opposite editorial-paper report. Its memorable device is one shared condition map: the same three muted status fields govern the overview, grouped summaries, registry rows, expanded evidence, and print.
keyCharacteristics: overview before provenance and row-level detail
cool, nearly neutral fields with low-chroma semantic color
calm humanist sans-serif typography and tabular figures
flat layers, open spacing, and minimal ornament
explicit status words and marks wherever color appears

rules.name: The Condition Continuity Rule
rules.body: A status keeps one semantic color from the top-level distribution through its table row and expanded evidence. General actions never borrow a status color.

rules.name: The Quiet Field Rule
rules.body: Status backgrounds must remain pale enough for long reading sessions while status ink and ordinary body text meet WCAG AA.

rules.name: The One Reading Voice Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce a display serif, ornamental font, or pervasive uppercase tracking to manufacture authority.

rules.name: The Evidence Stays Grounded Rule
rules.body: Expanded detail remains visually joined to its parent row instead of floating as an independent card.

dos: Do show the complete distribution and its denominator before methodology detail.
Do repeat status meaning with color, Russian text, and a distinct mark.
Do preserve stable IDs, source order, evidence links, and offline use.
Do make scanning comfortable for both a person and an automated agent.
donts: Don't style the report as a corporate analytics dashboard.
Don't use bright semantic colors, decorative textures, gradients, or gratuitous illustration.
Don't make every block a bordered card or expose every control at once.
Don't compress the registry until competency wording becomes difficult to read.
